description: This file defines iterator classes and macros for the Qhull library, enabling Java-style and mutable iteration over containers within the orgQhull namespace.
external_methods: C++ standard library: iterator, string, vector

classes.name: C##Iterator
classes.description: Iterator class for read-only traversal of container C, with methods to navigate and find elements.

classes.name: Mutable##C##Iterator
classes.description: Mutable iterator class for container C, allowing modification, insertion, and removal of elements.

classes.name: Qhull##C##Iterator
classes.description: Template class for iterating over Qhull container C, providing forward and backward traversal.

classes.name: QhullMutable##C##Iterator
classes.description: Template class for mutable iteration over Qhull container C, with modification capabilities.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assigns a container to the iterator, resetting its position.

methods.name: toFront
methods.description: Resets iterator to the beginning of the container.

methods.name: toBack
methods.description: Resets iterator to the end of the container.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if there are more elements ahead.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next element and advances the iterator.

methods.name: hasPrevious
methods.description: Checks if there are previous elements.

methods.name: previous
methods.description: Returns the previous element and moves the iterator backward.

methods.name: findNext
methods.description: Searches forward for a specific element.

methods.name: findPrevious
methods.description: Searches backward for a specific element.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the current element from the container.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the current element.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new element at the current position.
